```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(parzer)
library(stringr)

STEERoutplant<-read_csv("data/STEER pilot Outplant Data - Outplant Data11-15.csv")

#select columns
STEERoutplant<-STEERoutplant%>%
  select(Location, Outplanting_Date, Outplanting_Group, `Clump_ID_(tag)`, `Clump_lat/long`, Spp.Code,PlantNumber,NurseryTag, Containertype, `Plant_height(cm)`,Number_leaves,Clump_substrate,`Clump_water_depth(cm)`,`Plant_-me`,Notes)

```

```{r LatLong Formatting}
#I have a couple different formats of Lat/Long, need to make uniform
#most dates are decimal format, 8/27 is degrees minutes
unique(STEERoutplant$Outplanting_Date)
#7/31/25": N/W in front, needs to be fixed
#"1/30/26" looks good  just needs swap to -64
#"2/23/26" looks good, extra decimals +64 need -
#"3/23/26" looks good, -64
#"3/27/26" looks good -64
#"5/12/26" looks good -64
#"7/30/26" clump 4353 says 69, not 69 should be 64
#"8/27/26" in decimal degrees

unique(STEERoutplant$`Clump_lat/long`)

#a lot of the lat/longs are in different formats, need to standardize the formats. on 7/31/26 there is N/W in front of using if else to parse out the N/W and keep the numbers and dashes only on this date
STEERoutplant<-STEERoutplant%>%
  mutate(`Clump_lat/long`=ifelse(Outplanting_Date=="7/31/25", 
                                  trimws(gsub("[^0-9. ]", "", `Clump_lat/long`)), #trimws deletes the space that is created when N and W are removed, but leaves the space between lat and long so I can separate lat and long later, gsub in the brackets tells to replace everything that is not 0-9, space,- ,with blank ("") this deletes the N and W while keeping the decimals and numbers 
                                 `Clump_lat/long`))


#split lat and long into separate columns
#gsub, ("-\\s+") look for a minus sig n(-) followed by a space (\\s) or any number of spaces(+)
#replace any instance where minus sign and any combo of spaces with just a negative sign("-")
#else keep the OG lat/long

STEERoutplant <- STEERoutplant %>%
  mutate(`Clump_lat/long` = gsub("-\\s+", "-", `Clump_lat/long`)) %>%#there is a space after the - on 3/23 
  separate(`Clump_lat/long`, into = c("Clump_Lat", "Clump_Long"), sep = "[,\\s]+", convert = TRUE)
#then split the Lat Long column into Clump_Lat and Clump_Long, split by either, or space 

#fix the format of 8/27 using parse_lat and parse_long from the package parzer
STEERoutplant<-STEERoutplant%>%
  mutate(
    Clump_Lat = parse_lat(Clump_Lat),
    Clump_Long = parse_lon(Clump_Long)
  )

#now just want to make all the 64s negative, because we are in the western hemisphere
STEERoutplant<-STEERoutplant%>%
  mutate(Clump_Long=ifelse(grepl("^-", Clump_Long), #if there is a -
                           Clump_Long, #then leave it as Clump_Long
                           paste0("-", Clump_Long))) #if not then paste a - in front of Clump Long

 #this added a bunch of digits to the rows where I converted the format. it fixes when I convert to numeric        
str(STEERoutplant)   
STEERoutplant$Clump_Long<-as.numeric(STEERoutplant$Clump_Long)

#now to fix clump 4353 typo: -69.87380 should be -64.87380
STEERoutplant<-STEERoutplant%>%
  mutate(Clump_Long=ifelse( grepl("69.87380", Clump_Long, fixed = TRUE),
                                  -64.87380,
                                  Clump_Long))

```


```{r, Factors}
#Location, Species, Container Type, Clump Substrate

unique(STEERoutplant$Location)
#only one location

unique(STEERoutplant$Spp.Code)
#only RHMA

unique(STEERoutplant$Containertype)
# "4"      "3"      "3\" TP" "4\" TP" "3\"TP"  "4\"TP" 

STEERoutplant<-STEERoutplant%>%
  mutate(Containertype
         =recode(Containertype, "3\"TP"="3TP",
         "3\" TP" ="3TP",
         "3'' TP" ="3TP",
         "4\"TP" ="4TP",
         "4\" TP"="4TP",
         "3"="3TP",
         "4"="4TP"))

unique(STEERoutplant$Clump_substrate)
#only one option

unique(STEERoutplant$`Clump_ID_(tag)`)
str(STEERoutplant$`Clump_ID_(tag)`)
#nothing looks weird

unique(STEERoutplant$PlantNumber)
check<-STEERoutplant%>%
  filter(PlantNumber==8)
str(STEERoutplant$PlantNumber)
#interesting there is only one clump with 8 trees



```

```{r Dates}
#Outplant Date

library(lubridate)

unique(STEERoutplant$Outplanting_Date)
#all in the same format, mdy
str(STEERoutplant$Outplanting_Date)#currently as a character

#tell r its a date
STEERoutplant$Outplanting_Date<-mdy(STEERoutplant$Outplanting_Date)#nothing failed to parse
```

```{r Duplicates}

check<-STEERoutplant%>%
  group_by(`Clump_ID_(tag)`, PlantNumber)%>%
  summarise(N=n())%>%
  filter(N>1)#no duplicates!

```
